verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents headless-friendly operation. You can launch the server from a terminal (`uvx arize-phoenix serve`, Docker, Kubernetes), drive it from a CLI (`npx -y @arizeai/phoenix-cli setup`, `px setup mcp`), and run evaluations through Python and TypeScript SDKs with control over pipelines. Dataset evaluators work as an evaluation harness similar to a unit test suite. However, the evidence never explicitly describes CI usage. Missing for 10: documented CI integration (e.g., GitHub Actions or CI recipes), pass/fail exit codes or regression gating in pipelines, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless CI runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
